articles.headline: Hajime Moriyasu unbothered how he's remembered. Perhaps that is his Japan legacy
articles.description: Hajime Moriyasu is not bothered by how he will be remembered as Japan coach -- and perhaps that is the legacy he leaves behind.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: Hajime Moriyasu's time in charge of Japan came to an end on Tuesday with the Samurai Blue falling to a 2-1 loss to Uruguay in an international friendly at Singapore's National Stadium.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: In his farewell chapter, Hajime Moriyasu was received widespread adulation from the Japan faithful but insists he hasn't thought too much about how he will be remembered by.

articles.headline: Stoic until the end, Japan's Hajime Moriyasu can finally let emotions flow
articles.description: Even up until the eve of his final game in charge of Japan, Hajime Moriyasu remained solely focused on the task ahead.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: Having taken over the Japan reins after the 2018 FIFA World Cup, Hajime Moriyasu will manage the Samurai Blue for the final time on Tuesday against Paraguay at Singapore's National Stadium.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: Hajime Moriyasu ultimately did not succeed in helping Japan claim a first-ever knockout win at the FIFA World Cup, but he did guide them from 55th in the FIFA rankings to their current position of world No. 17.

articles.headline: Stars set Singapore alight as Japan exact revenge on Brazil with dramatic late win
articles.description: Japan have exacted revenge over Brazil for their World Cup elimination with a dramatic 3-2 win in Singapore on Saturday.

images.name: Japan vs. Brazil [1296x729]
images.caption: Japan exacted revenge on Brazil for their heartbreaking World Cup elimination earlier this year by recording a 3-2 win over the latter in Singapore on Saturday.
images.credit: Roslan RAHMAN / AFP via Getty Images

images.name: Japan vs. Brazil: Raphinha; Hiroki Ito [1296x729]
images.caption: After claiming a two-goal lead inside the opening 19 minutes, Japan allowed Brazil to get back into the game before sealing the win with a dramatic winner in the 91st minute.
images.credit: Roslan RAHMAN / AFP via Getty Images

articles.headline: Brazil revenge mission hands Japan opportunity to finish Hajime Moriyasu legacy on a high
articles.description: Despite it being a friendly match, Japan will have much to play for against Brazil on Saturday -- for more than one reason.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: With the 2027 AFC Asian Cup postponed from January to December, Japan's upcoming friendlies against Brazil and Paraguay in Singapore are likely to be their last matches under coach Hajime Moriyasu.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: Japan fell short in their quest to reach the FIFA World Cup quarterfinals for the first time earlier this year, after a goal conceded in the 95th minute led to them falling to a heartbreaking 2-1 loss to Brazil in the round of 32.

articles.headline: Socceroos transfer tracker: Where Australia's stars will play in 2026-27
articles.description: Transfer deadlines are hitting across the globe and, with it, bringing to an end a window that has seen a remarkable surge in interest in players who represented the Socceroos at the FIFA World Cup.

images.name: Alessandro Circati, Nestory Irankunda and Lucas Herrington [1295x729]
images.caption: Alessandro Circati, Nestory Irankunda and Lucas Herrington
images.alt: Alessandro Circati, Nestory Irankunda and Lucas Herrington

images.name: Mo Touré bags quickfire double for Norwich City
images.caption: Mo Touré explodes for two goals within the space of 20 minutes as Norwich City thrash Burnley 4-1 in the Championship.

articles.headline: Japan 'came here to win the World Cup, not fun' - Yukinari Sugawara
articles.description: Japan wingback Yukinari Sugawara has reiterated that his team are at the World Cup not just to participate, but to win it.

images.name: Yukinari Sugawara [1296x729]
images.caption: Japan's preparations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup saw them record first-ever wins over Brazil and England, following on from their huge upsets over Germany and Spain back in the 2022 edition of the tournament.
images.credit: John Walton/PA Images via Getty Images
